author: /root/core_v12_final_review
verdict: V2 is a narrow recommended refinement suitable for isolated testing. No observed native option/optgroup defect asserted.
source_rationale: Including option/optgroup is defensive refinement of the explicit inheritance policy, not a proven current option-style failure. V1 252-probe result does not test native popup entries. No product optgroup literal exists at this snapshot; do not manufacture one as evidence of a reachable product feature.
execution_plan: Freeze full current frontend source/public/config/package hashes and served CSS module original text. Serve exact isolated V2 CSS with all other current source unchanged; record baseline and candidate endpoints separately. Deny unexpected mutations; use disposable RAM fixture for remaining GETs.

Run all19actual routes with a returned superadmin fixture so Limits is reachable. Use actual desktop/mobile navigation, light/dark, widths320/390/768/1280 and three browser engines sequentially. This is24browser contexts and456route observations; context/route/probe counts must remain distinct. On narrower budget first run320/1280 both themes all engines (12contexts/228routes), then complete390/768 before full responsive scope is claimed.

At each route wait for its actual selected navigation/title and settled loading state. Record actual fixture population, role and loading/error/empty branch. An empty route is not numeric-category coverage. Existing overview/analysis/leave/units/compute comparison fixture data must retain independent exact expected formatter values.

Collect every visible numeric text instance in meaningful product leaves and each rendered numeric value control, preserving route/selector/DOM identity/text/value, computed numeric variant/font family/size/weight/line height, bounding rectangle and local scroll ancestor. Require tabular-nums where policy applies; classify images/canvas/SVG and browser internals separately instead of silently omitting.

Verify no page-wide overflow and no new clipping/overlap at numeric labels, values, toolbar buttons and primary action groups. Intentional table/disclosure horizontal scrolling is allowed only with a reachable container. Include longer returned dates, large counts, decimal percentages/runtimes, negative/zero/min/max values that obey existing contracts. Do not alter numeric values to fit.

Before/after CSS comparisons must retain exact rendered strings and native value/type/min/max/step/selected-option attributes, plus font family/size/weight/line height and permissions/disabled/read-only states. Digit widths and wrapping may legitimately change; inspect affected layout rather than demanding byte-identical geometry.

Inspect actual member Details base-call select and Roles dated-call selects/options while editing a local draft; actual Limits data-limit-num/data-limit-choice controls; unit minimum-free number input; working-month and compute-month inputs; date controls in actual normalized Add/Edit forms; numeric-option pagination/filter controls when present. Read option computed styles even while native popup is closed. Never add representative synthetic select/optgroup elements and call that product proof.

For actual enabled native numeric controls, use real focus/keyboard/open-and-Escape operations and verify labels, selected values and form behavior. If a local draft is changed, restore through the same actual control and cancel without saving. Assert zero API mutations. Record platform differences in native picker/popover rendering rather than forcing custom widgets or changing appearance.

Expand actual comparison/chart details and member workload/history/dated-role sections; inspect existing readonly IDs/code/monospace numeric text as distinct font families. No baseline font-family replacement or proportional-nums exception is justified solely by this refinement.

Optional actual-text digit-advance measurements may use DOM Range rectangles for existing numeric text runs when that run contains distinguishable decimal digits. Record font readiness and script/bidi/kerning limitations. Do not infer support for all digits/all installed fallback fonts from a few equal advances, or present computed CSS as measured glyph shaping.

Run applicable original31 six-category test freshly against V2, then broad route/control checks. Preserve raw failures and distinguish missing/hidden-selector or fixture failures from actual styling regressions. No unchanged historical252pass report is recast as V2 execution.

Before integration review exact CSS-only patch, original31 complete instance inventory/accepted conditions and prior56 responsive applicability. Then apply only held CSS bytes, run fresh applied tests,114unit/build gates as appropriate and review package. Physical devices/nativeAT remain pending; original31 is not accepted by this design artifact.
native_control_limits: No browser execution or candidate acceptance. CSS computed values do not prove every installed font implements tabular glyphs. OS native popup/picker internals may ignore author font styling and are not certified by DOM computed option/input styles.
V1 evidence remains frozen and is not retroactively attributed to V2. New exact-CSS checks and broad responsive regression must run before applying.
